entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I'd like to start a return for a helmet I recently purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?
It's just a preference. The color wasn't quite what I expected from the pictures online. The box is still unopened, so it's in perfect condition.
I understand completely. We want to ensure you're happy with your gear, especially when it comes to something as important as safety. Can I get your order number to pull up the details?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order here for the VeloFit Summit helmet. It looks like it was delivered 16 days ago, on December 11th. Is that correct?
Great. I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can approve this return for a full refund for you right now.

That's excellent news, thank you. Now, since I have to go through the process of shipping this one back and placing a new order for a different color, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for my next purchase, just for the inconvenience?

I appreciate you asking, and I understand the logic. Unfortunately, our system doesn't allow for goodwill credits or discounts for preference-based returns. However, I can generate your pre-paid return shipping label and email it to you immediately, so you can get the process started without any delay.
Alright, no discount then. That's a shame, but getting the label right away works for me. Please send it over.

Of course. I've just sent it to the email address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off with any carrier. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
